articles.title: Ocean cold snaps can imperil sea turtles. Rescuers can help
articles.snippet: Climate-driven ocean changes are stranding thousands of sea turtles on beaches, too cold to swim or eat. Special hospitals give some a fighting chance.
articles.summary: Climate-driven ocean changes are stranding thousands of sea turtles on beaches because they are too cold to swim or eat. Special hospitals are now helping some of these turtles survive.

articles.title: Some video games offer mental-health benefits
articles.snippet: The PlaySmart video game lowered teens’ symptoms of depression. This benefit was still there a year after they stopped playing the game.
articles.summary: A video game called PlaySmart lowered depression symptoms in teens. This mental health benefit lasted for a year after they stopped playing.

articles.title: Four T. rex footprints hint at how fast it traveled
articles.snippet: Though poorly preserved, the prints suggest the dino ambled at 1.6 meters per second, roughly the speed of a human walking briskly.
articles.summary: Four newly discovered Tyrannosaurus rex footprints suggest the dinosaur traveled at a speed of 1.6 meters per second. This pace is roughly equal to the speed of a human walking briskly.
